🔒 Coach — verify scores

Coach: check this athlete's entered scores are correct, then enter the coach password to mark them verified. Only verified scores count toward the card, Total Power and class unlocks. If the athlete later changes a score it returns to pending until you verify again.

Privacy & your data

What we store. Your name, sex, optional age, your test scores and training logs, and an optional photo.

Where it's kept. In this beta everything is saved only on this device, in your browser — it isn't sent to a server. When the full Unranked app launches, you'll be asked to create an account and your data will move to secure storage then.

Why we store it. To show your athlete card, your six stats, your Total Power and your class rankings.

Your choices. You can edit or clear your data at any time. Clearing removes it from this device. To have your data removed, just clear it here or ask a coach.

Good to know. This is a private beta for testing. Scores are self-entered and coach-verified; nothing here is medical advice.
